mcq.question: What is the primary purpose of Annual Worth (AW) analysis?

options.A: To compare alternatives based on their annualized cash flows.
options.B: To calculate the total present worth of an investment.
options.C: To determine the salvage value of an asset.
options.D: To find the internal rate of return of a project.

mcq.explanation: AW analysis is used to compare alternatives by converting all cash flows into an equivalent annual amount.
